Pathophysiology
Brief Overview of Normal Cell Growth
In order to understand the pathophysiology of cancer cells, it is
important to review the basic principles of normal cell growth.
All cells reproduce during the embryonic phase, but only some 
cells continue to reproduce after the ﬁ rst few months following 
birth.
